commits.author: Siborne
commits.message:
fix: correct DataUtils error codes and ThreadFactoryBuilder assertion

- DataUtils.checkUpdateOne/checkDeleteOne delegated to checkInsertNums, so
  update/delete failures were reported as "save failed" (INSERT_ERROR)
  instead of UPDATE_ERROR/DELETE_ERROR.
- ThreadFactoryBuilder.setThreadFactory asserted on the unrelated
  uncaughtExceptionHandler field instead of its own backingThreadFactory
  argument, rejecting valid factories and accepting null.

Add regression tests for both.

commits.author: Siborne
commits.message:
fix: invoke publisher afterCompletion after event dispatch

syncPublish called PublisherInterceptorChain.triggerAfterCompletion before
EventBus.post, so interceptor cleanup/teardown ran before subscribers were
invoked, and a post exception never reached afterCompletion. Align with
asyncPublish: invoke afterCompletion after dispatch, passing the exception
when dispatch fails.

commits.author: Siborne
commits.message:
fix: prevent failed sends from being marked as successful

Two bugs in the send path caused events that actually failed to send to be
persisted as TRANSFER_SUCCESS and silently lost (that state is not covered
by the compensation scanner):

1. AbstractSenderAdapter.doSyncSendMessage: the catch block recorded the
   failure via sendFailed but lacked a return, so sendComplete ran right
   after and overwrote TRANSFER_FAILED back to TRANSFER_SUCCESS.

2. BatchSendResult.addFailedIndex: a copy-paste error appended failed
   indexes to sendCompletedIndexList instead of sendFailedIndexList, so
   AbstractSenderAdapter.sendList only ever saw an empty failed list and
   marked every event as completed.

Also add the missing junit test dependency to easyevent-transfer-api and
regression tests for BatchSendResult.

commits.author: Siborne
commits.message:
test: add regression test for pom parent version consistency

Verifies that every pom.xml whose <parent> belongs to com.openquartz
references the root ${revision} placeholder (or its concrete value), so a
future version bump can never silently desync a module again.

commits.author: Siborne
commits.message:
fix: sync easyevent-admin parent version with root revision

The root pom.xml uses the CI-friendly placeholder ${revision} (currently
1.6.0-beta), but easyevent-admin and easyevent-admin-server hard-coded
1.5.0-beta as their parent version. The mismatch made Maven fall back to
resolving com.openquartz:easy-event:1.5.0-beta from remote repositories,
which fails with a FATAL "Non-resolvable parent POM" error and breaks the
whole reactor build.

Align both poms with every other module by using ${revision}.
